versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of afrexai-board-reporting

- No file changes detected in this release.
- The board reporting framework and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Initial release of the board reporting framework.
- Transforms raw business data into investor-ready board reporting packages for monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles.
- Includes templates for monthly flash reports, quarterly board decks, annual reviews, committee reports, and meeting prep.
- Provides comprehensive metrics frameworks, SaaS benchmarks, industry-specific board priorities, and anti-patterns to avoid.
- Features a practical checklist and templated structures for effective, transparent board communication.
